summary: Phase I-2 closure for the immutable Nex Core plan: optional feature layers (nex-zfs, nex-cluster) are documented as an on-host Core contract (nex-core-local layers list|ensure|disable|activate, layer-unavailable with its reasons) and nex-layers.service ships enabled by a vendor wants link and preset; an optional build mode that wrote the Controller appliance as a separate content-addressed payload (--appliance-packaging split) was added here and removed again in the 2026-10-02 review fixes, so the nex-core-local deb always carries the appliance and core-local-setup uses /var/lib/nex/payload/<sha256>/ only for configure --controller-image-sha256 (the Controller system image); the graphical installer wizard gains the same Repair image choice as the text wizard; installer integration scripts pin the installer hook. Review fixes of 2026-10-02 to the layer build (layer-finalize puts package defaults into shared /etc directories with a tmpfiles C+ rule instead of a C rule that skips them, and its early-target check now covers *.requires and *.upholds directories; build-zfs-modules.sh takes its default snapshot from image/snapshot) and corrections of the layer QA record and the optional-features guide (nex-cluster was built and live-merged in lab 3; the update engine stages layers).

guide.reason: New page for operators to list, enable and disable optional feature layers from the host's root shell; the guide index links it. Corrected after review: nex-cluster is no longer described as unbuilt, and the page says the update engine stages layers (unit-tested, not run on a booted installed image).

api.reason: New on-host command contract only: `nex-core-local layers` (activate, list, ensure, disable), the LayerInfo schema and the layer-unavailable refusal with its reasons, in docs/API.md and the local OpenAPI x-commands. No HTTP route, report-protocol command, Inventory field or Controller behaviour is added, and the Controller stores nothing about layers.

roadmap.reason: Phase I-2 of a proposed, not yet authorized plan; development work with no published milestone changed and nothing run on a booted image.

state.reason: The layer manager runs in Core on the host and keeps its own journal; the Controller is not involved.
state.record: /var/lib/nex/layers/enabled.json (per layer: enabled, sha256, base_build_id, changed), the store /var/lib/nex/layers/store/sha256-<hex>.raw and the signed manifests under /var/lib/nex/layers/releases/<BUILD_ID>/, all on the host's nex-data volume. A fresh Controller recovers nothing from these and needs nothing, because the host reads them from its own disks.

verification.method: Ran scripts/generate_api.py and --check, tests/test_api_contract.py, tests.test_storage_packaging, tests.test_core_local_package, installer/check.sh and tests/integration/installer-handoff.py. Compiled installer/gui/nex-wizard.c and nex-config.c with gtk+-2.0 and glib in a throwaway Debian trixie container (-Wall -Wextra, no warnings) and ran tests/integration/installer-disk.py there under Xvfb. Smoke-ran the bundled, split and invalid branches of the appliance packaging in build-inside (the split mode it exercised was removed in the 2026-10-02 review fixes).sh against a stub bundle. Simulation only: the wizard Repair choice was compiled but never drawn or clicked, no package was built, and no installed image or ISO was booted. Review fixes: python3 -m unittest tests.test_image_composition (29 tests; the new ones fail against the previous scripts and pass now; the C+ test runs the real systemd-tmpfiles --root against a finalized layer). Simulation only: no layer was rebuilt and no host merged a layer after these fixes.
